name: Certification Due Reminder (Legacy)
description: Sent to certification reviewers one week after a certification campaign starts and every seven days after that, until they sign off or the campaign ends.
subject: Reminder: Your certification review requires attention
body:
Certification review still open

Dear ${ownerName},

The certification "$certification.certificationGroups.get(0).name" is still open and needs to be completed.#if ($certification.expiration) Please finish this certification by the due date below.#{end}

Due date: $spTools.formatDate($certification.expiration,3,0)

Select here to complete the certification.

Thank you for your attention to this review in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.
